fieldData.description:
Radix community meet up's are a great way to learn more about Radix and DeFi, get involved with a project, or just meet up with like-minded individuals in your area. If you have a project you would like to announce, please contact the event host.
For more information please contact the Kentucky Event Ambassador @OfficiallyTimeWasted via the Telegram Meetup Channel. https://t.me/Radix_Meetup.
fieldData.name: Community Meetup - Lexington, Kentucky
